functionalRequirement: System shall provide an interface for Application Administrators to reset user passwords.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement multi-factor authentication for administrator password reset actions, requiring at least two verification methods (e.g., admin credentials + temporary 2FA code).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures only authorized administrators can reset passwords, preventing unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Accountability: Log all password reset actions with timestamp, administrator ID, and user affected, retaining logs for a minimum of 180 days.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a comprehensive audit trail for security monitoring and potential investigations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Implement password reset workflow with clear validation rules, including mandatory complexity checks and prevention of reusing last 5 passwords.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Guides administrators through a secure and controlled password reset process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: Ensure password reset functionality can be completed within 5 minutes, with automatic system rollback if the process fails midway.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Minimizes disruption and ensures administrators can quickly resolve user access issues.

functionalRequirement: System shall be able to perform distance calculations and access geo-location information for the user, sites, and nearby sites.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Complete distance calculations within 100 milliseconds for up to 1,000 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures rapid response times for geo-location and distance-related queries.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: Limit memory consumption to 50 MB per geo-location data processing request.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Optimizes system resources during distance and location calculations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: Encrypt all geo-location data transmissions using TLS 1.3 with AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive location information during data transfer.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: Maintain distance calculation accuracy within 1 meter for 99.9% of valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures precise and reliable geo-location and distance information.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow prospective applicants to research requirements and select relevant services or applications to initiate online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: Provide a clear, intuitive navigation flow with maximum 3 clicks to access service requirements and selection interface.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Simplifies the process for prospective applicants to find and select services.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: Implement context-sensitive help tooltips for each service selection step, accessible via a '?' icon.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides guidance to users during the service research and selection process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: Support responsive design compatible with minimum 95% of modern web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and screen sizes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures accessibility across different devices and browser platforms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Load service requirements and selection interface within 2 seconds for 99% of user interactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a responsive and efficient user experience during service research.

functionalRequirement: System shall allow staff members to develop staff reports for publication and distribution.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: Provide a drag-and-drop interface for report content management with auto-save functionality every 3 minutes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances ease of use and prevents data loss during report creation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: Design report creation system with plug-in architecture supporting at least 5 different report template types.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows for future extensibility and customization of report generation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain 99.9% uptime for report creation and distribution systems during business hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures consistent access to report development tools.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: Implement version control for all reports, tracking changes with author, timestamp, and ability to restore previous versions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides accountability and traceability for report modifications.

functionalRequirement: User shall be guided to a login page after successfully registering, where they can enter their credentials to access the application.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement mandatory multi-factor authentication with options including SMS, email, or authenticator app verification.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances login security beyond basic username and password.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Provide clear password entry guidelines, including minimum 12-character length, complexity requirements, and real-time strength meter.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Guides users in creating strong, secure credentials.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Redirect to login page within 500 milliseconds after successful registration.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures a smooth, immediate transition to login after registration.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain login system availability of 99.99% with automatic failover mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents login interruptions and ensures consistent access to the application.
